Depths shown by contours and soundings. Title from map sheet no. 1. Black, red, and blue pen-and-ink on tracing linen. Includes 11 cross-sections and 2 tide registers. Map sheets individually numbered: No. 1 - 4. Production date varies by sheet from June 19, 1856 to July 25, 1856. Sheet no. 1 and 3: Traced by S. B. Linton. Sheet no. 2: Traced by Jno. A. Campbell. Sheet no. 4: Traced by Campbell and Hode. Sheets no. 3 and 4 have alternate statement: sent to Hon. John A. Dix. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
